moments.title: Glasgow hosts Commonwealth Games
moments.blurb: The 2026 Commonwealth Games are currently underway in Glasgow, Scotland, featuring around 3,000 athletes from 74 nations competing across 10 sports until August 2nd.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: The Commonwealth Games are in full swing in Glasgow! Which events are you glued to this weekend? So much incredible talent on show. #Glasgow2026

angles.name: Scottish Pride
angles.copy: Scotland is buzzing as Glasgow hosts the Commonwealth Games! The city is alive with sport and celebration until August 2nd. What a spectacle!

moments.title: AIG Women's Open tees off
moments.blurb: The AIG Women's Open, one of golf's major championships, begins on July 29th and runs until August 2nd at Royal Lytham and St Annes in England.

angles.name: Golf Excitement
angles.copy: Get ready for world-class golf! The AIG Women's Open begins July 29th at Royal Lytham and St Annes. Who are you backing for the title this year?

moments.title: CONCACAF U-20 Championship underway
moments.blurb: The 2026 CONCACAF Under-20 Championship for men's football is currently taking place in Mexico, running from July 25th to August 9th.

angles.name: Football Fans
angles.copy: Young footballing talent on display! The CONCACAF U-20 Championship just kicked off in Mexico, running through to August 9th. Any future stars to watch out for?

moments.title: Bruno Mars lights up Wembley
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Bruno Mars is playing live at Wembley Stadium tonight, July 25th, as part of 'The Romantic Tour 2026', with another date on July 28th.

angles.name: Concert Tonight
angles.copy: Wembley Stadium is getting romantic tonight! Bruno Mars is LIVE in London for 'The Romantic Tour 2026'. Who's there for the 24K Magic?

angles.name: Artist Focus
angles.copy: Bruno Mars bringing the heat to Wembley tonight and again on Tuesday! Which of his hits are you hoping to hear live? 'Uptown Funk' or 'Grenade'?

moments.title: Latitude Festival concludes today
moments.blurb: Latitude Festival, held at Henham Park in Suffolk, wraps up its 2026 edition today, July 26th, after a weekend of music, comedy, and arts.

angles.name: Festival Wrap Up
angles.copy: That's a wrap for Latitude Festival 2026! Who had an amazing weekend at Henham Park? Tell us your highlight!

angles.name: Post-Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Latitude Festival is winding down today. From the music to the comedy, what was your favourite moment of the weekend?

moments.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
moments.blurb: Sir Mick Jagger, the iconic frontman of The Rolling Stones, celebrates his 83rd birthday on July 26, 2026.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Tomorrow, rock legend Mick Jagger turns 83! Still strutting, still singing. What's your all-time favourite Stones track?

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Happy almost birthday to the one and only Mick Jagger! The Rolling Stones frontman celebrates 83 years of rock 'n' roll tomorrow. An absolute icon!

moments.title: Luke Combs takes over Wembley
moments.blurb: Country music superstar Luke Combs brings his 'My Kinda Saturday Night Tour' to Wembley Stadium for three nights, starting July 31st and running until August 2nd.

angles.name: Country in London
angles.copy: Luke Combs is coming to Wembley next weekend for three huge nights! Get ready for a 'My Kinda Saturday Night' London style!

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Who's buzzing for Luke Combs at Wembley Stadium next week? Three nights of country anthems from July 31st! What's your must-hear track?

moments.title: Grace Jones at Crystal Palace Bowl
moments.blurb: The legendary Grace Jones will perform at Crystal Palace Bowl in London on July 31st as part of the new 'Palace Bowl Presents' festival series.

angles.name: Iconic Performance
angles.copy: Get ready for an icon! Grace Jones is bringing her trailblazing show to Crystal Palace Bowl on July 31st. A night not to be missed!

angles.name: Music Legend
angles.copy: Grace Jones live in London next week! The ultimate performer is at Crystal Palace Bowl on July 31st. Which of her hits will you be dancing to?

moments.title: Camp Bestival Dorset approaches
moments.blurb: Camp Bestival Dorset returns to Lulworth Castle from July 30th to August 2nd, featuring a diverse lineup including Bastille, Fatboy Slim, and Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Family Festival Fun
angles.copy: Camp Bestival Dorset kicks off next week at Lulworth Castle! Who's heading down for the family fun, music, and good vibes from July 30th?

moments.title: Wilderness Festival starts soon
moments.blurb: Wilderness Festival takes place in Oxfordshire from July 30th to August 2nd, promising four days of music, arts, and immersive experiences.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Counting down to Wilderness Festival! Oxfordshire's big summer celebration starts July 30th. Who's got their tickets ready for a wild weekend?

moments.title: Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival
moments.blurb: Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival, Scotland's summer music celebration, runs from July 30th to August 1st in the Scottish Highlands.

angles.name: Highland Festival
angles.copy: The Scottish Highlands are calling! Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival kicks off July 30th for three days of incredible music. Who are you excited to see?

moments.title: Y-Not Festival in the Peak District
moments.blurb: Y-Not Festival returns to Pikehall, Derbyshire, from July 30th to August 2nd, bringing a mix of indie, rock, and pop to the Peak District.

angles.name: Peak District Vibes
angles.copy: Y-Not Festival is just around the corner! From July 30th to August 2nd, the Peak District will be alive with music. Who's going?

moments.title: Joe Elliott turns 67
moments.blurb: Joe Elliott, the lead singer of rock legends Def Leppard, celebrates his 67th birthday on August 1st, 2026.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to Def Leppard's incredible frontman, Joe Elliott, on August 1st! Pour some sugar on that cake!

moments.title: Chuck D turns 66
moments.blurb: Chuck D, the influential leader of hip-hop group Public Enemy, celebrates his 66th birthday on August 1st, 2026.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Pioneer
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the legendary Chuck D of Public Enemy on August 1st! A true pioneer who changed the game. What's your favourite Public Enemy track?

moments.title: Suzi Gardner turns 66
moments.blurb: Suzi Gardner, guitarist and co-founder of the punk rock band L7, celebrates her 66th birthday on August 1st, 2026.

angles.name: Grunge Queen
angles.copy: Shoutout to the incredible Suzi Gardner of L7, who turns 66 on August 1st! A true force in punk and grunge. What's your favourite L7 anthem?

moments.title: James Hetfield turns 63
moments.blurb: James Hetfield, the lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist of heavy metal icons Metallica, will celebrate his 63rd birthday on August 3rd, 2026.

angles.name: Metal Legend
angles.copy: Prepare to salute a metal legend! James Hetfield of Metallica turns 63 on August 3rd. What's your ultimate Metallica track? Nothing else matters!
